name: field
purpose: An expr formula on each cell of an n x n grid, for a pixels block. Row i and column j go from 0 to n - 1. The formula can also call noise(i, j): a value with mean 0 and variance 1, the same for the same seed, i and j.
returns: a list of n rows of n numbers

expr.doc: the formula of one cell over i, j and number state keys, for example "(i + j)/30 + noise(i, j)"

n.doc: the number of rows and columns, from 1 to 64

seed.doc: the seed of noise; another seed gives other noise

example.expr: sqrt(1 - t/1000) * (i + j)/30 + sqrt(t/1000) * noise(i, j)
